trust_decision.summary: Who may put ffmpeg options into the transcoder command: the custom hwaccel JSON (decode/encode flags, scale filters) is unmarshalled and appended verbatim to ffmpeg argv in the cassette package, and the handler-level 'privileged mediastream setting' check only treats ffmpeg/ffprobe paths as privileged, so an untrusted-origin request can set hwaccel=custom with arbitrary flags (e.g. an extra output file).

landing_point.why: Grepping the setting name TranscodeHwAccelCustomSettings (internal/database/models/models.go:479 -> internal/mediastream/repository.go:245) leads to the only live place the custom JSON is unmarshalled into ffmpeg flags.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the HTTP guard makes hwaccel=custom a privileged (trusted-origin/password) setting, a solver can argue the custom profile is an admin power-user feature whose flags are meant to be free-form, so validating flag contents in the cassette library is unnecessary; the legacy transcoder copy can be dismissed as dead code that nothing imports.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate custom profiles must keep working: built-in-equivalent flags like -c:v h264_vaapi -profile:v high, -crf 20.5, -tune fastdecode,zerolatency, scale filters with %d / %[1]d placeholders and iw/2 division, format=nv12|vaapi,hwupload chains; non-custom hwaccel changes from an untrusted origin stay allowed; same-server LAN browser and localhost may still save screenshots into the configured folder.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extra profile field (e.g. audioEncodeFlags or extraOutputFlags) appended to the audio pipeline argv, not covered by validateCustomProfile.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The profile is a plain JSON schema; adding audio-encoder knobs for hardware users is a natural feature, and a maintainer would extend the struct and pipeline without touching the validator.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Re-wire the legacy transcoder as a fallback (e.g. when cassette init fails) so its unvalidated custom-settings parser becomes reachable.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The legacy package is still in the tree with the same options struct (internal/mediastream/transcoder/transcoder.go:32-40); a fallback is a plausible maintainer change and is a true second implementation at distance.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An environment/setting-driven device string (like SEANIME_TRANSCODER_VAAPI_RENDERER) sourced from user settings instead of env and placed after -hwaccel_device without the device pattern.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Device selection is a common user request; moving it from env to a UI setting is a small change that bypasses the custom-profile validator because it is a built-in profile.
